title: CI: add Amazon Linux 2023 target
description: Amazon Linux 2023 runs kernel ~6.1, is RHEL-compatible, and is widely deployed on AWS. Likely deployment target for customers. Needs new AMI owner/pattern and dnf package names (similar to CentOS).
close_reason: Amazon Linux 2023 kernel-6.1 passes 19/0. AMI owner 137112412989, pattern al2023-ami-2023*kernel-6.1-x86_64, ec2-user, dnf.
